task_description: Write a method in Dafny to check if each element of second sequence is smaller than its corresponding element in the first sequence.
specification_response:
Method Signature:
    method AllSecondSmallerThanFirst(seq1: seq<int>, seq2: seq<int>) returns (result: bool)
Postconditions_prompt:
    - The result is true if and only if for all indices i within the length of seq2, seq2[i] < seq1[i]
- The input sequences remain unchanged
code_response:
Step 1: Determine the method’s signature.  
In this case:  
```dafny
method AllElementsInSecondSmallerThanFirst(seq1: seq<int>, seq2: seq<int>) returns (result: bool)
```  

Step 2: Determine the preconditions.  
Natural language description:  
- Both sequences should be of the same length to compare elements at corresponding positions.  

Dafny specification:  
```dafny
requires |seq1| == |seq2|
```  

Step 3: Determine the postconditions.  
Natural language description:  
- The result is true if and only if, for every index, the element in seq2 is strictly less than the element in seq1 at that position.  

Dafny specification:  
```dafny
ensures result <==> forall i :: 0 <= i < |seq1| ==> seq2[i] < seq1[i]
```  

Step 4: Write the code, its formal specification, and the verification annotations that help the solver prove the postconditions.  
```dafny
method AllElementsInSecondSmallerThanFirst(seq1: seq<int>, seq2: seq<int>) returns (result: bool)
  requires |seq1| == |seq2|
  ensures result <==> forall i :: 0 <= i < |seq1| ==> seq2[i] < seq1[i]
{
    result := true;
    var i := 0;
    while i < |seq1|
        invariant 0 <= i <= |seq1|
        invariant result ==> forall k :: 0 <= k < i ==> seq2[k] < seq1[k]
        invariant !result ==> exists k :: 0 <= k < i && seq2[k] >= seq1[k]
    {
        if seq2[i] >= seq1[i] {
            result := false;
            break;
        }
        i := i + 1;
    }
}
```
